PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This soup starts with roasted pumpkin.

Slow-roasted until naturally sweet, then blended with coconut milk, garlic, scallions, and warm spices.

The texture is thick and comforting, the flavor lands between savory and gently sweet.

Simple, cozy, and built to show up.

 

 

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌾

It’s rich without feeling heavy.

Roasting brings depth, coconut keeps it smooth.

Works hot or cold, on its own or with bread.

 

 

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Roasted pumpkin, scallions, garlic, vegetable broth, coconut milk, organic agave syrup, extra virgin olive oil, spices

 

 

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Coconut
May contain traces of: Soy, Nuts, Gluten

 

 

HOW TO EAT 🍽️

Heat until fully hot, or enjoy chilled.

Stir well before serving.

 

 

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE ❄️

Storage: Keep refrigerated at 0–4°C at all times
Shelf life: See packaging

 

 

FREEZING & DELIVERY NOTE ❄️

This product can be frozen for later use.
When frozen, it can be kept for up to 2 months.
During delivery, the soup may arrive frozen or partially frozen due to temperature control.
If so, store it in the freezer or allow it to defrost naturally in the refrigerator before heating.

Energy 218kcal
Fat 16.5g

Roasted pumpkin & coconut soup
